tts.instructions: Voice: a warm, grounded teacher who genuinely likes their students. Tone: calm, curious and a little wry; never salesy. Pacing: unhurried and conversational, with a small breath at each em dash and a real pause after questions. Pronounce 'Keating' as KEE-ting. This film is brisk: keep each line crisp with short pauses, a touch more energy than usual.

scenes.text: Keating 4.0 starts by getting to know you.
Every step is optional. Chat is one click away.
Tell it how much to ask before it tells. What to do when you're stuck. Where its analogies come from.
Accessibility choices are requirements: plain language, captions, easier type, less motion.
Longer goals become pursuits — close by, while today's question still leads.
Reshape the teacher itself: its persona, its voice, how it speaks.
Then choose Show me around — on the screen you're actually using.
